reuse.why: Uses the shared getMonthWideCategories selection, getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and the mutator/undoable wrapper, though it re-states the income/tracking skip and expense sign flip that siblings also inline.

duplication.why: The per-category loop with the `is_income && !isTrackingBudget()` skip and the expense sign negation is a copy of the pattern in set3MonthAvg/setNMonthAvg rather than a shared helper.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts alongside them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler registration/type and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small, idiomatic and consistent with siblings; the repeated income-skip and sign rule remain scattered across actions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection goes through getMonthWideCategories; budget writes through setBudget.

disguised_duplication.where: The income skip and sign flip in setLastMonthSpending follow the sibling actions' pattern openly (sign flip written as a ternary instead of `*= -1`), not disguised.
